about.en: My Lovely Coin (MLC) is the utility token of My Lovely Planet, a mobile game in which in-game actions such as planting trees fund real-world environmental projects run with partner NGOs. Its main deployment is the Polygon PoS token 0x0566c506477cd2d8df4e0123512dbc344bd9d111, with further issuer deployments on BNB Chain and Solana.
